items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: I want you to work a couple of weeks here for Scassas... I got there with my band.

ctx.x: And Sacassas had the band La Conga. Sacassa got to go away for a couple weeks. So the man send for me. So I went over there. He said, I want you to work a couple of weeks here for Scassas. All right. (Inaudible).

So he say, well, you got (inaudible) open 2:00 o'clock in the afternoon until the rest of the show. I say all right. I got there with my band. His orchestra was close to the bar, close to the bandstand. I start rehearsing the act. He opened the door. (Inaudible) the office. Hey, hey, hey. This -- I stopped the man, said, what did you say? No, no, no, you don't play. I said, listen, I'm the leader of this orchestra. I'm a musician. You let me finish the rest of my show. I said, I don't play (inaudible) interfere…
